The public JFK sample is from whisper.cpp v1.9.4:
https://github.com/ggml-org/whisper.cpp/blob/v1.9.4/samples/jfk.wav

jfk.flac is a lossless conversion with macOS afconvert. These fixtures contain no user recording.

jfk.mp3 is a 128 kbps MP3 conversion of the same public sample using ffmpeg/libmp3lame.
